# Synthetic Speedway Race Card - NASCAR Test Car | Open | 80 laps

Bottom line: [D] Run 2 followed incomplete optional repair; use Run 1 for clean coaching

- Start: [I] Give up two mph on entry and release the brake earlier
- Long run: [I] Hold one steering arc and delay throttle until wheel unwind
- Strategy: [D] Fuel window opens near Lap 36 with a two-lap reserve

## Corner playbook

### Load zone 1 entry
- Early: [D] Obs E128/M112/X121 mph; B24%
- Middle: [D] Target E126/M113/X123 mph; B21%
- Late/older-set proxy: [I] Release earlier; protect minimum speed

### Load zone 2 center/exit
- Early: [I] One arc; throttle after apex
- Middle: [I] Reduce correction and unwind sooner
- Late/older-set proxy: [I] Wait for wheel unwind before full throttle


## Race triggers

- Tire phase: [I] After 12 green laps, trade entry speed for one steering arc
- Pit: [D] Pit from Lap 36 with two-lap reserve; caution changes the window
- Adjust/rollback: [I] Validate a clean repaired-car run before the next setup change
